description: The Chile-ED-Resp team publishes a curated weekly respiratory emergency-demand series derived from Chilean Ministry of Health DEIS/SADU administrative records. Zenodo version 1.1.0 covers 2022 to 2025 on a 209-position statistical-week calendar. The article describes 180 hospitals, 12 official respiratory causes and a long table of 449,844 rows; a forecasting table has 37,620 hospital-week rows. The release distinguishes explicitly reported zeros from missing source records and includes processing and rolling-origin evaluation code. Geographic coverage is Chilean hospitals at facility-week resolution. Zenodo lists a public ZIP and CC BY-NC 2.0, so access is free but commercial reuse is restricted. The series can calibrate emergency-department arrival demand or stress-test hospital staffing simulations. It excludes non-hospital emergency units and relies on administrative coding; 178 of 180 hospitals meet the authors’ target-coverage threshold. The package and processing code were not downloaded or run. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
